ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a food web; on the left side there is "Grass", and there is an arrow from Grass pointing to Deer, indicating that deer feed on grass. Reasoning: The question asks, if the number of deer increases, how the amount of grass will change. Because deer are consumers of grass, more deer will eat more grass, so the grass population will decrease.
